answer: Each epoch every identity locks a ocean bond of $1,000 before grading, and the chain compares each grade against the consensus of a random 21-grader committee drawn from 5,000 staked identities. A pigment grade diverging more than 15 percent from consensus triggers an on-ledger slash trail that burns half the bond. One honest agent risks a single $1,000 bond, while ten fakes must lock $10,000 and lose half on every divergent grade, and atlas correlation checks expose coordinated voting rings. Repeat divergence freezes all linked identities.
